messages:
andrea-support: Hey SRE team — multiple customer tickets (2 Enterprise, 1 PLG) reporting a sudden increase in 5xxs and timeouts for hosted inference in us-west-2. Started ~10m ago. Customers see 502/504 and a few 'upstream read timeout' in their logs. Can you triage? :eyes:
omar-sre: seeing the SLO page — p99 latency and 5xx rate spiked at 14:02 UTC. Alert-bot fired a SLO-burn alert: hosted-infer.usw2.p99 > 1.5s. Pulling graphs now.
linh-obs: adding dashboard link: https://console/redwood/dashboards/hosted-infer-usw2 — endpoints /v1/generate and /v1/chat are the worst offenders. Traces look sparse, lots of gateway spans with no downstream runner spans (trace gap).
ryan-eng: repro steps from a customer: curl to API returns 502 within ~3s. Example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"hi"}' -i
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Connection: close
Server: redwood-gateway
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 14:05:01 GMT
```
They also pasted gateway logs showing `upstream write timeout` and a few `connection reset by peer`.
andrea-support: tickets mention one commonality — requests include an X-Billing-Org header for the two enterprise customers. PLG customer doesn't include it but still hit issues. Not sure if billing path matters.
omar-sre: rerunning some live queries — log groups show increased 502s from gateway->router connections failing to establish to runners around the same time window. Suspect a runner autoscale/rotation event or ephemeral network flaps.
linh-obs: query I ran (splunk-esque):
```
index=infra logs source=gateway | where status in (502,504) and region=="us-west-2" | stats count by upstream_component, error_message
```
results: most are `router: connection reset` or `runner: handshake timeout`.
sre-oncall: any recent deploys or infra changes? I don't see scheduled deploys in the last hour. No config changes in load-balancer.
ryan-eng: I found a small spike of NAT gateway throttling in the same AZ per cloud provider metrics — maybe ephemeral egress issue to runner hosts? Could explain connection reset.
omar-sre: good find. Also seeing an Amazon ENI attach/detach noise in logs around 14:01 in a subset of runner nodes. If runners lost their network briefly, gateway would show upstream write timeouts and missing traces.
andrea-support: customers want ETA and mitigation. Any short-term mitigation we can offer?
linh-obs: immediate mitigations: 1) route traffic to another region (us-east-1) for enterprise customers (we have multi-region routing), 2) enable fallback model variant (lower resource runner) which is on different pool, 3) bump retries at gateway for 5xx transient errors for affected customers.
sre-oncall: I'll initiate a regional routing fallback for the two enterprise accounts and notify support to guide them. Also open runbook step to drain/replace affected runner hosts.
omar-sre: creating a temporary dashboard to monitor trace-gap ratio and per-AZ runner health. Also raising a ticket with cloud provider for ENI/NAT noise.
ryan-eng: quick repro for devs: run a high-rate curl loop to /v1/chat and watch gateway logs; you'll see `upstream handshake timeout` then no runner spans. Code: 
```
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' & done
```
Stop after 10s if your env shares traffic with prod.
andrea-support: pinging customers with suggested region failover and apologies. One asked if this is related to billing header — we should confirm.
omar-sre: not seeing any auth/billing-specific errors. Correlation appears coincidental (two enterprise customers on same AZ). Will keep investigating.
linh-obs: follow-ups: 1) add log query to alert on trace-gap ratio > 20% for 5xx windows, 2) instrument gateway to include runner node id in more logs to speed host-level triage, 3) add a short-term synthetic probe for gateway->runner handshake latency.
sre-oncall: ack. I'll run through runbook: replace 3 affected runner instances in az-a, toggle routing for enterprise tenants, and set retry policy to 1 extra attempt for gateway within next 15m.
andrea-support: customers notified, will update tickets once routing completes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
alert-bot: [ALERT RESOLVED] hosted-infer.usw2.p99 returned to baseline at 14:24 UTC. SLO-burn cleared.
omar-sre: postmortem candidate — save traces, host eject logs, and cloud ENI events. I'll start a short incident write-up and include timelines + mitigation steps.
ryan-eng: noted — will add reproduction snippets and steps to triage doc.
andrea-support: closing the escalation after customers confirm recovery.
